integrity: Exhaustive exact Groebner criteria and an independent structural proof of the rational-base-point upper bound; an executable complete finite checker is supplied. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for the fixed nonsplit smooth quadric over GF(2). No claim for other finite fields, other linear systems, or all geometric members of the pencils. Base Frobenius types outside maximal orbit not classified. Publication priority can be affected by unindexed work.
title: All-smooth anticanonical genus-one pencils on the nonsplit binary quadric
